meta.scope: Saudi Arabia Batch 3 — Labour/Saudization, Public Investment Fund, and banking densification.

candidates.title: Labour force and Saudization statistics
candidates.publisher: GASTAT / Ministry of Human Resources related
candidates.description: Labour-force participation, unemployment and Saudization indicators. Overall and Saudi unemployment have declined markedly; female participation has risen; private-sector Saudi employment share is a core Vision 2030 target and is tracked closely.
candidates.notes: Core labour-market and Saudization node. Tightly linked to Vision 2030.

candidates.title: Public Investment Fund assets and investment framing
candidates.description: Statistics and framing of PIF total assets and investment activity. Assets have grown into the multi-trillion-riyal range; the Fund is the central vehicle for domestic mega-projects and international diversification under Vision 2030.

candidates.title: Banking system credit and asset-quality statistics
candidates.description: Statistics on banking system credit growth and non-performing loans. Credit has expanded with economic activity; NPL ratios remain relatively contained in recent readings.
candidates.notes: Core banking-system structural and risk node.

candidates.title: Saudi Arabia labour–PIF–banking densification meta-node
candidates.publisher: Derived from labour, PIF and SAMA sources
candidates.description: Meta-node binding labour/Saudization statistics, Public Investment Fund framing, and banking credit/asset-quality statistics into a coherent labour–sovereign-investment–financial layer.
